Assist the Property Officer with operating expense budgets, capital expenditures, value-enhancing programs, and cost-efficient resource management. Oversee the 24-hour response standard for tenant service calls, maintain equipment history records, and submit monthly billing summaries to the Property Accountant.

jobs.title: Production Support Associate

This role is ideal for candidates who are eager to grow, develop new skills, and build a long-term career with us. The PSA is responsible for managing the end-to-end order process, including sales order creation, purchase order generation, proof approvals, quality checks, shipping, tracking, and invoicing. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Successful candidates will have experience in sales operations, order management, or branded merchandising, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a desire to take on new challenges. If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your career, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a growing team, we’d love to hear from you

This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines.
